published_ranges._nozzle_by_speed: basic 170-195 (20-50 mm/s, bed 0-50); high-speed printers setup 180-215 (50-200 mm/s, bed 0-60) [product page + guide 8/2024]; TDS 175-195
published_ranges._notes: PLA + polyhydroxybutyrate (PHB) compound, no annealing needed; temperature resistance up to 110 C. Guide: do not exceed 210 C unless printing at high speed, start around 180 C. Page high-speed fan reads '80 - 200 %' (typo as printed). Density 1.20 g/cm3 (ISO 1183); TDS also lists 1.05 g/cm3 under ISO 1133 (melt). 1 kg + 210 g spool; 2.85 mm also sold.

conflicts: Drying: TDS gives 65 C 2 h; drying table (12 Oct 2023) gives 70 C 2 h; guide 8/2024 gives 75 C 5 h.
